name: 12921-batchdecode-r1w4afp8-tp8
model: Barrrrry/DeepSeek-R1-W4AFP8 -- MoE expert weights int4, everything else FP8. Needs `trust-remote-code`.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=20, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 240 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts centred on 100 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 64-192) and generations centred on 1000 tokens (stdev 200, clamped 600-1400). Seed 42.
purpose: A long-form reasoning assistant generating thousand-token answers from brief prompts for 20 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form, read one `key: value` per line. A nested or re-flowed block is DROPPED
# silently and the engine then starts without it, so every value must stay on ONE line --
# `cuda-graph-bs` in particular.

model-path: Barrrrry/DeepSeek-R1-W4AFP8
tp-size: 8
context-length: 10240
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.75
random-seed: 42
max-running-requests: 20
page-size: 1
disable-radix-cache: true
disable-overlap-schedule: true
prefill-attention-backend: flashinfer
decode-attention-backend: flashinfer
flashinfer-mla-disable-ragged: true
cuda-graph-max-bs: 32
cuda-graph-bs: [1, 4, 8, 16, 20, 24, 32]
